headline: Ukrainian drones have hit Russia's largest data centre, run by Sberbank, the latest in a week of strikes on Russian AI computing sites.
score_reason: Kept at pool score: confirmed attack, unclear damage.
importance_line: Data centres that train AI are now war targets, which could slow Russia's AI work, though neither company says whether any supercomputer was damaged.
summary: Reuters reports that the strike on Sberbank's Balakovo data centre followed three attacks in the past week on data centres run by Yandex, and that Sberbank confirmed the attack while saying its services are running normally. Neither company says whether supercomputers used to train AI models were damaged; both say they already trail US and Chinese AI leaders by up to nine months, partly because of sanctions on advanced chips.
notes: Reuters page blocked; Reuters text read on KSL and CNA. machine_action true: drones carried out the strike.
